description: This file defines the AOS_Line_Item_Groups class which extends the AOS_Line_Item_Groups_sugar class, providing methods to save and manage line item groups in the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic for handling group data, interacting with BeanFactory, and saving related products and services.

classes.name: AOS_Line_Item_Groups
classes.description: Class extending the base sugar class, adding custom save functions for handling grouped line items in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save_groups
methods.description: Handles the saving of multiple groups from POST data, manages deletion, creation, and association of group beans, and links products/services.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to include additional utilities before calling parent save.
